brief.headline: Push to extend payment to 51 days (what they give their own suppliers) while offering faster payment for a price cut of roughly 12%

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of roughly 12%, or move the volume to a listed converter
priceAsk.target: A discount of about 12.16% (the rate they borrow money at) if we pay faster, or benchmark finished laminate quotes from Huhtamaki or UFLEX
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachets is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg) and the verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)', meaning we're at the high end. Their cash is stuck for 101d vs 64d for similar firms, so paying them faster is worth their borrowing rate of 12.16% to them. We can also price-check with two listed converters who already supply FDC or can scale.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Push to extend payment from 30 days to 51 days (what they give their own suppliers), freeing up ₹53.19 L for us
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹53.19 L cash freed up for us by moving to 30-day terms from immediate (or maintaining 30 vs tightening). Extending another 15 days frees ₹26.60 L more.

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only 2.3% profit on every ₹100 sold, and they owe 1.25x their own cash (₹282.62 Cr debt), so cash is tight. Their cash is stuck for 101d vs 64d for similar firms, meaning they badly need faster payment. We're 0.61% of their ₹1064.86 Cr revenue—small but not tiny—and their credit rating is CARE BBB+ / Stable with a health score of C (46/100) and an Altman Z of 2.36 (grey zone). Push firmly on price or payment, but not so hard we tip a fragile supplier over; they have EPF payment delays flagged. Line up a second source (Huhtamaki or UFLEX) to shift volume if they don't move.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter already supplying FDC in small volumes—proven and scalable for laminate sachets; revenue ₹2755.75 Cr, health C (58/100)

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion—can second-source at scale; revenue ₹16492.00 Cr, health C (46/100)

risks: Credit rating CARE BBB+ / Stable and Altman Z 2.36 (grey zone)—watch supply security, don't squeeze so hard we destabilize them
EPF payment delays flagged—a sign of cash stress; if we push too hard on price they may cut corners or delay deliveries
We have no internal best-price benchmark for laminates (no other vendors in our data)—so we lean on the market ask and the two listed alternates to test their price
Only 2.3% profit margin—very little room; a big cut could hurt them and our supply, so tie the ask to paying them faster (worth 12.16% to them) rather than a straight cut
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to match the 51 days you give your own suppliers—and if you can match the market midpoint of ₹250/kg or offer us 12% off for paying faster, we'll commit the volume and lock in a longer contract.
